File: src/components/ExportButton.tsx

Persist the user's selected export format in localStorage so that subsequent mounts of the ExportButton component remember the previous choice instead of resetting to the default format every time.
args.title: Persist export format selection in localStorage

args.body:
label: feature
file: src/components/ExportButton.tsx
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The ExportButton component should remember the user's previously chosen export format across mounts by persisting it in localStorage.
